1.explanation: Tile/Tile.mdx and its overview cover how ExpandableTile and the “interactive” variant are intended to work (including aria-expanded toggling). StructuredList docs explain why putting a StructuredList inside a Tile triggers the non-interactive Tile variant. Button/Button.mdx and Button/docs/overview.mdx describe default button behavior and allowed ARIA attributes, which is the core of the violation—aria-expanded isn’t allowed on a plain button in this context. Together, these documents show the component APIs, expected behavior, and underlying ARIA constraints needed to reproduce and fix the issue.
1.bug_scenario: In the Storybook “Expandable With Interactive” tile example the StructuredList inside the ExpandableTile is non-interactive, so the tile renders as a native <button> with an aria-expanded attribute. IBM’s Accessibility Checker flags this with “ARIA attribute is not allowed: aria-expanded=\"false\"” because that attribute isn’t permitted on a button without the proper interactive wrapper. As a workaround a hidden <button> was injected to force the “interactive” variant (only the expando icon becomes a button), but that blows away aria-expanded when collapsed. The screenshot shows the Tile panel open on “Expandable With Interactive,” the Accessibility tab reporting a single critical ARIA violation on #expandable-tile-1.
